source_caption:
📺 The Mentalist (2008–2015)

The Mentalist follows Patrick Jane, a brilliant former psychic medium who uses his extraordinary observation skills, psychological insight, and clever manipulation to help law enforcement solve complicated murder cases. Working alongside Teresa Lisbon and her investigative team at the California Bureau of Investigation, Jane notices tiny details others overlook, allowing him to uncover hidden motives, expose lies, and outsmart dangerous criminals. Despite his charming personality and playful attitude, Jane carries a tragic past after a mysterious serial killer known as Red John murdered his wife and daughter. Driven by guilt and a desire for justice, he secretly pursues the killer while helping solve crimes. Combining clever mysteries, unexpected twists, sharp humor, and emotional storytelling, the series explores revenge, justice, deception, and the extraordinary power of observation.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Mystery • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode • 7 seasons • 151 episodes

🎥 Creator: Bruno Heller

🏆 Recognition: Starring Simon Baker and Robin Tunney, the series became one of CBS’s most popular crime dramas. Simon Baker received a Primetime Emmy nomination and a Golden Globe nomination for his performance as Patrick Jane.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Mentalist is an American procedural drama television series that ran from September 23, 2008, until February 18, 2015, broadcasting 151 episodes over seven seasons, on CBS. It was created by Bruno Heller, who was also its executive producer. The show follows former "psychic" Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), who is a consultant to the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI), and his boss, senior agent Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney). Jane uses highly developed observational skills to "read" people's minds and to solve murder cases.
